checks.name: Catalog completeness

checks.name: Boundary refusals
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test models boundary_refusals::
checks.output: 6 tests pass: crossing a sovereignty zone and crossing a provider account are each typed refusals rather than switches; a session-bound provider does not migrate and health alone is not a reason; a permitted switch is a new turn revision carrying its cache and context consequences; a switch with no successor turn revision is a typed refusal; and an exhausted revision space never masks a boundary crossing (the boundary check is reached first).

checks.name: Pool containment
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test models pool_containment:: && rustc --edition 2024 --emit=metadata --extern automonique_protocol=rust/target/debug/libautomonique_protocol.rlib -L dependency=rust/target/debug/deps - (nested with_credential_pool rotation)
checks.output: 7 tests pass: a pool carries the identity and policy it was declared with and refuses an account whose tenant/billing/data-boundary policy differs; an account outside the pool has no handle; rotation inside one pool names both accounts; rotation to self or to an unusable target is refused; usage and exhaustion are observable from a credential coordinate only. I compiled the cross-pool rotation directly -- source handle from pool-a, target handle from pool-b -- and rustc rejected it with two occurrences of error[E0521] (borrowed data escapes outside of closure), so the invariant-lifetime brand is what stops it, not a runtime check, and the compile_fail at src/models.rs:1926 fails for its intended reason. No accessor returns a credential value.

checks.name: Fallback preservation
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test models fallback_preservation::
checks.output: 6 tests pass: each auxiliary class declares its own chain independently, a chain needs at least one hop, a chain preserving every semantic is declarable, a chain whose next hop weakens a semantic is refused at declaration rather than at dispatch, every hop is measured against the head rather than its predecessor (so weakening cannot be reached by small steps), and the first weakening hop is the one named in the refusal.

checks.name: Untrusted advice
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test models untrusted_advice:: && rustc --edition 2024 --emit=metadata ... - (let result: AggregateResult = reference;)
checks.output: 5 tests pass: a reference call receives a minimized context, only the aggregator produces the result and advice stays labelled advice, every reference call is a counted usage record against tenant budgets, and advice and result text are bounded before being recorded. I compiled the promotion `let result: AggregateResult = reference;` and rustc rejected it with error[E0308] (mismatched types), so a reference output cannot become an authoritative record. Recorded honestly rather than counted against the row: UntrustedAdvice::expose_untrusted returns a &str that Aggregator::conclude would accept, so the words can be copied; the test repeating_advice_verbatim_is_still_the_aggregators_own_record covers that case and shows what the types still hold is authorship and usage accounting, not wording.
